name: Photo OCR
description: Extracts searchable reading-order text from new photographs in bounded batches.
prompt: When photographs arrive, extract visible text from preview derivatives in bounded batches. Preserve absent confidence and never send originals.

vault.why: Reads photograph previews and derivation stamps, then writes validated searchable text.

delegateStep.latency: Specialist OCR usually takes tens of milliseconds; a delegate step takes seconds.
delegateStep.consequence: Changing variant re-derives eligible photographs; delegate steps are billed.
